description: This class defines the ZoneDescription entity, representing localized descriptions for zones with references to Zone and Language entities. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping in a Java-based project.

classes.name: ZoneDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing a description of a zone, including associations to Zone and Language entities, with database constraints.

methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize a ZoneDescription with zone, language, and name.
